label: Cylinder
depicts: Simple cylinder shape with an oval top and two straight side walls
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain three dimensional cylinder with a closed side wall.
avoid_when: Do not use for the cut cylinder when the center should look open like an H shaped gap.

label: Cylinder
depicts: Open cylinder ring with an oval top and one centered h shaped cut
use_when: Use when the interface wants a hollow cylinder form with a clear center opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the closed cylinder when the side wall should stay solid.

label: Desk Lamp
depicts: Table lamp with a trapezoid shade above a short stem and one small pull dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple table lamp with a wide shade and tiny pull dot.
avoid_when: Do not use for the angled desk lamp when the arm and pointed shade should lean to one side.

label: Desk Lamp
depicts: Angled desk lamp with a bent arm above a pointed shade and round base joint
use_when: Use when the interface wants an adjustable desk lamp leaning forward on a bent arm.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straight table lamp when the shade and stem should stay upright.

label: Diamond
depicts: Tall diamond outline with four long sides and pointed top and bottom
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple diamond outline without internal gemstone facets.
avoid_when: Do not use for the cut gemstone when flat top edges and facet lines should be visible.
